wp-color-picker-alpha (minified)
=================================
Source: https://github.com/kallookoo/wp-color-picker-alpha
File:   dist/wp-color-picker-alpha.min.js (GPL-2.0-or-later, same as WordPress)
Pinned: matches plugin handle sto-wp-color-picker-alpha version 3.0.4 in includes/Assets.php

Ship this file with the plugin so admin color pickers load the Iris alpha extension
( opacity / #RRGGBBAA ) when enqueued.
